card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: Responds to the second piece of a split medical word or heading, such as 'emat' in erythematous, 'Int' in Intolerable or 'Her' + 'editary'. It also appears on a few short linking words in label text.

modes.label: Inside split medical terms
modes.description: The middle of a long clinical term that is broken into pieces.

modes.label: Start of a word in a heading
modes.description: The opening piece of a word in a section heading or table title.
modes.example: [see Warnings and Precautions (5.7) ]<< Int>>olerable Grade 2 or Grade

modes.label: Short linking words
modes.description: A short word such as have or with before a clause about patients or reactions.
modes.example: within 30 minutes after completion of the infusion, however some<< have>> occurred hours after an infusion.
